verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS design platform like Canva, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The audit logs it does document record user activity for admins, which is a different feature and the opposite of an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
